Supreme Court Shocked by Cancer Drug Price Hike

The Supreme Court of India expressed shock over the "broad daylight dacoity" of cancer drugs being sold at Rs 27,000 after being supplied at Rs 2,700. The court criticized the overpricing of essential cancer medications.
